indiaInboundRemittances.sourceLabel: World Bank Open Data, personal remittances received

data.method: Derived metro estimate = US-to-India corridor estimate multiplied by the market share of national Asian Indian population.
data.rounding: Display rounds to one decimal billion for values above $1B, nearest $100M below $1B, and never implies precision.

usShare.sourceLabel: RBI Bulletin March 2025, Sixth Round of India's Remittances Survey

caveats: Per-market values are derived order-of-magnitude estimates.
The allocation uses Asian Indian population share, not observed Xpat transfers.
meta.method: Fetched World Bank India inbound remittances and combined them with the latest RBI US-source share for a derived corridor estimate.
meta.refreshCadence: annual when World Bank and RBI remittance data refresh
meta.source: World Bank Open Data and RBI Bulletin
